notes.title: 16 Nov 2021
notes.content: Added on screen control help - These can be disabled in the options menu

I've added more small fish to all venues, you should be able to catch them using the Waggler float rig with maggots or redworm. These fish are more active in summer and during the day, colder months and nighttime will slow them down.

notes.title: 9th Nov 2021
notes.content:
All venues are now "remastered" and have more foliage and in some cases higher resolution terrains. This is a work in progress and more uniqueness will be added.

You can turn up or down the level of grass and extra trees from within the options menu. You may need to lower these levels if your PC is struggling.

notes.title: 4th Nov 21
notes.content:
Added simple controller vibration support
Other minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the baitboat not being able to be controlled issue when not using the baitboat follow camera.

Fixed some other small bugs

notes.title: 1st Nov
notes.content: Fixed an issue when trying to play online with venues that were previously locked.

notes.title: 31 Oct 21 notes
notes.content:
Fix an issue where the Radar markers didn't hide when selecting something else.
Fixed some trees on Pinetree lake being too high and not on the terrain

notes.title: v2.2.6 - 30th Oct 2021
notes.content:
All Venues and Tackle are now [b]unlocked by default[/b] as there were issues causing players to lose their progress. This also removes the 'grind' that people didn't really enjoy. [u]Remember, you still need to fish in real time to enter your fish catches to the leaderboards![/u]

An XP style progression system [i]may [/i]be introduced in the future but this has yet to be decided.

Enjoy the venues and tackle!

notes.title: Update notes for 26th Oct 21
notes.content:
Fixed an issue in multiplayer games where if you hooked a fish your character looked in the opposite direction of the fish.

Steam Cloud now backs up your coins/purchases, your stats and your Radar POIs

notes.title: Notes for update 20/10/21
notes.content:
[b]Added a completely new character controller with smoother controls.[/b] You may need to re-adjust your look sensitivity as the mouse input has been toned down to match the controller input more closely.

[b]Fixed some issues regarding the tackle box screen:[/b] The system remembers and loads in what was last selected so you should be able to just swap a rig or a bait and not have to select both like before. Also if you change pegs your setups remain intact, so you can just close the tackle box menu and continue fishing.


[b]Added Russian and Polish languages

Translated the bait and rig descriptions[/b]

notes.title: Update Notes for 16th October
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a setting in the menu that enables you to turn off the rod recentering when playing a fish.

[*] Added 'Quick Select' inputs to allow selection of the rods and bait boat via a key instead of using the select menu. Again, if they're not working please enter the controls menu and either reset the controls or remap them to the inputs you require. By default they are 1,2,3,4,5,6 and attaching rigs to the bait boat has been moved to the number pad numbers 1,2,3,4. Feel free to change them as you require.

[b]Note: No defaults have been assigned to a controller as there are not enough buttons to make this comfortable but feel free to change as you see fit.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: More bugs fixed & added throwing loosefeed
notes.content:
Fixed resolution & full screen bugs

Fixed online bug where player couldn't select equipment

Made peg details and marker rod display easier to see

Throwing loosefeed is now working.

[i][b]To throw loosefeed Press and hold T or B button on controller and release when you have enough power. If you find this doesn't work you'll need to goto the controls menu from the main menu and either reset all the controls or enter what key you want to use manually at the bottom of the peg selected category.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Added control mapper
notes.content: Added Control Mapper option on the main menu, click the controls button.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Look Sensitivity Slider can be lowered more & also added another Slider to the settings menu as well as the pause menu
[*] Fixed character models still spawning when switched off in the settings
[*] Fixed leaderboard not hiding when pressing L or releasing fish
[/list]

notes.title: Finally, the update is released!
notes.content:
Hey all, v2.2.5 is now available.

If you've played the mobile version you'll notice it's very similar with the following differences:

[list]
[*] No IAPs, all items can be purchased via in game coins, all coins are earned from catching fish.

[*] Multiplayer is unlocked by default and yes, it's cross platform so you can play with those on mobile.

[*] Graphics are higher resolution. They could be better and I'll work on improving them in the near future

[*] Your mobile data is not compatible with the Steam version of the game.

[*] Game has full controller support as well as mouse/keyboard
[/list]

There are still some known issues I have to fix/add. These include:

[list]
[*] No way to change your controls

[*] Pinetree lake is remastered on PC and so is not able to be played online against anyone on mobile until the mobile version is also updated

[*] Leaderboards in your profile page do not work yet
[/list]

I plan on posting the controls in the Community, but eventually I'll add in game prompts etc

As always please report any bugs/issues on the Steam community and hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Your input is needed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, as you know the game is in Early Access, this means I'm still working on the game and you are welcome to offer your feedback to help shape the game.

Right now there is about 10 active people giving me feedback in the community. Not many at all.

Please pop over to the community and answer some of the questions in the posts and help make this the best fishing simulation possible.

Thanks

notes.title: Latest info - 23rd June 2017
notes.content:
Work continues on the updated version of CFS. I hope to release an opt in beta as soon as possible. As some of you know, this will be a complete rewrite of the game you are currently able to play.

I've been posting videos and screenshots of my progress in the community, so i suggest you visit that and take a look at what's to come, I hope you like what you see!

notes.title: New version of CFS
notes.content:
Hi all,

As some of you may know and have been testing an update to v1 of CarpFishSim which includes lots of new features from the mobile version.

This version is now the default version and all other test versions are at the moment removed until there is a new test version for you to try.

All players will now be on the same version.

Don't forget that if you get stuck in game, press F1 to see what the keys are.

Tight lines.

notes.title: What's going on?
notes.content:
Hello all, some of you may notice it's a little quiet. Don't worry though, work is continuing full time but at the moment they are on things that take more time, new venues being one of them. This means that it will be some time before a new update will be released, but when that update is released there will be some new venues to try at least.

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Build 21 is now online
notes.content:
Build 21 is now online and contains a lot of changes both in what you can see and 'under the bonnet' that you can't see, as a result of this please report any bugs here & they shall be squashed.

What's new:

New networking. The networking has been completely overhauled and now you will see other players around the lake. This is bound to still be buggy so please give your feedback as constructively as possible.

Venue editor. The venue editor is available under the create option on the menu, there hasn't been anything new added since the video below was released but it will give you an idea of what to expect. You can walk around your lake but you can't catch fish yet. Again your feedback is welcome.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=suV15uPkQHA

Menu system. The old menu system has been updated to give a cleaner feel.

Again, please post any issues here. Thanks

notes.title: v2.0.0 build 20
notes.content:
Build 20 fixes the resolution issue some of you were having.

I'm still looking in to the blank screen issue. I've disabled the screen fade for now, please let me know if you have any more issues when catching or releasing the fish.

notes.title: How to play v1 of Carp Fishing Simulator
notes.content:
Many of you have asked how to play v1, which had more features than the state of v2.

Here's how.

1. Open your game library in Steam.
2. Right Click Carp Fishing Simulator in the list on the left.
3. Select properties
4. Select the BETAS tab on the far right of the properties window.
5. Select 'Old_v1_version - Old version of Carp Fish Sim'
6. Click close in the bottom right of the window.

http://i.imgur.com/huzpqW8.png

The old version should now download. Please note that v1 of carp Fish Sim is no longer being updated.

If you'd like to switch to the latest version, follow the above instructions again but select 'opt out' from the list.

notes.title: v2.0 build 19
notes.content:
Build 19 fixes issues with catching fish, particularly the blank screen after catching 2 fish.

Also added is visual fx options to the options menu. You can now turn on or off various fx. If you're on a slow PC you might want to turn all fx off for better in game performance.

Let me know how you get on and don't forget to hit F12 and post your biggest catches to Steam!

notes.title: Beta v2.0 build 18
notes.content:
This update addresses the fish, of lack of them being caught. I've fixed some bugs in the fish AI that was stopping them taking your bait. They're now much easier to catch, too easy in fact. This is so i can gather your feedback on the playing, landing and releasing of the fish.

The image FX are also a work in progress, some like it, some don't so I'll include options to turn it on or off in the options menu. Turning it off should also improve performance a little for those playing on laptops.

notes.title: v2 beta 17 is public build.
notes.content:
In order to keep moving forwards, the latest v2 beta build (17) and any future builds are now the default build and all players will automatically download the new version.

What this means is that we'll have more people testing the new version and hopefully giving feedback.

If you were on the public beta, you'll need to change back to the 'No beta' option in order to download the default version. The public beta has been removed so will no longer be updated.

If you would like to play the old v1 version, you still can for now, until the v2 version is out of beta, here's how you do it:

    Open Steam
    Open the Library tab
    Right click on Carp Fishing Simulator in list on the left
    Select properties from the menu
    Select the Betas tab at the top
    From the drop down menu, select old_v1_version - Old version of CFS
    
The old version will now be downloaded. Please note you cannot have the beta & the old version at the same time.

notes.title: v2.0.0 Beta (build 16) Now available
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming due to summer getting in the way of working full time.

Anyway, v2.0.0 Beta (build 16) has just gone live. 

There's been a fair amount of changes that you probably won't notice. Here's a little summary of what's changed that you will notice.

Netting the fish - You can now net the fish. Press the L key on keyboard or the X button on controller. You'll notice your arm now holds the net, when you press the button again you'll drop the net, it doesn't matter where it is when you pick it back up, it'll appear in your hand, this was a conscious decision to try and eliminate frustration when netting fish. Also, you need to be holding the landing net in order to net the fish. It will be no longer possible for a fish to be netted without you holding it.

Releasing a fish - This is still a work in progress. After netting a fish, the screen will fade out and the fish will be in your unhooking mat/cradle. To view the fish walk over to it and you can look at it. When you want to release the fish press the I key or B button. At the moment looking at and releasing the fish is missing a lot of features but at least you can catch and release fish now.

Playing fish - A lot of tweaks have been made to the way fish fight, please leave your feedback in the community as we'd love to hear what you think.

notes.title: v2 Beta version now available
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The v2 beta version is now available but before you jump right in, I'd like to take this opportunity to explain a few things about it.

1. Please don't download it if you're not willing to provide CONSTRUCTIVE and MEANINGFUL feedback.

2. There is much less gameplay in the beta version, only common carp of only one size are catchable. You cannot select your bait or tackle yet.

3. You can Run, walk and creep which is called stealth. You will spook the fish if you run or if you walk and are near them. You will not spook them if you use stealth.

4. Once a fish is tired it will stay at the edge of the lake near your feet. At the moment you can't land it and so you'll need to quit & restart the game. I'll be working on landing mechanics next week.

5. Online mode kind of works. There's some issues to please report what you find in the steam community. Press T whilst online lets you chat. Press T and then escape closes the chat window.

That's about it for now, here's how to download the beta:

Open Steam find Carp Fishing Simulator in your library list on the left, right click it and select properties. You should see this window:

http://i.imgur.com/kM08j3A.png

Go to the Beta tab on the far right and select the Beta from the drop down list.

It should start downloading. If you want to return to playing the normal release, you'll need to do the same but select 'opt out of beta' and you'll redownload the old version.

Have fun.

notes.title: Create A Bait v3.0.0 now available.
notes.content:
A New version of our bait creation tool 'Create A Bait' is now available for free download from our website http://ddinteractive.co.uk/carpfishsim/create-a-bait-2/

New features include the ability to add company and bait images and a complete user interface redesign.

If you've never used our 'Create A Bait' tool before, it's simple. Give your bait a name, a company name & description, change the colour of it, add images and as many flavours as your imagination will allow. Behind the scenes Create A Bait works it's magic and your saved baits can be used in Carp Fishing Simulator and shared with friends online.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3 - New Fish: PIKE
notes.content:
Due to a lot of requests I've added Pike as the new species. To fish for them you'll need to use one of the 3 new Deadbaits from the 'Other' folder in your bait selection menu. Only Pike, Perch and Catfish will take a Deadbait so for those of you wanting to target the predators in the lake you can now do so. This is a work in progress so at the moment there isn't any 'Pike tackle' such as traces and treble hooks, so for now just set up as you would for Carp but use a deadbait.

Also in this update I've tweaked the new water, please let me know what you think so far.

Tight lines.

notes.title: v1.0.2 Now available
notes.content:
v1.0.2 addresses some issues.

Firstly the water bug where some players have none. I've tried to replicate this but non of my systems are having the issue so I've added new water, which hopefully will work on those players systems who are having issues, it's not as nice to look at as the old water yet but it's better than no water at all.

The old water is still in the game and you'll notice below the option to select your start month there is a checkbox to enable/disable the new water. If you have no issues with the old water you don't need to change it, just leave it unchecked and you'll be fine.

Secondly players we're reporting that the game hangs at a blank screen after clicking play. What is really happening is the game is loading but taking longer than usual due to their system. I've added a loading screen so players are not confused by the black screen.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 released.
notes.content:
Just uploaded a little update, fixes some issues with the weather, perch and adds Steam stats support for Fish Caught and Fish Lost.

I've also made a few tweaks to the game in the hope it will fix some of the issues people have been having, please let me know if it works or not if you've been having issues.

Cheers

notes.title: What's next for Carp Fishing Simulator?
notes.content:
Firstly, thanks for all your support, it's really appreciated.

Are you wondering what the future will hold for Carp Fishing Simulator? Then read on....

The version of Carp Fish Sim that you (hopefully) now own on Steam is the current playable version but we have been working for months and months on v2 which is being completely rewritten from the ground up. This new update features improvements on the fishing tackle physics, fish AI amongst other things and also adds extras like a full character customisation system.

Below is a Youtube playlist of work in progress videos showing some of these features, please keep in mind that the graphics on some videos are from the mobile version and/or an older version of the game and don't represent the final graphics you will see.

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkS1l5Yc671ej2gKuR7MjO9UdneqJfXC_

So where are we now?

Well, the issue with rewriting a game that's already released from the ground up is that we have to get the game back to a level the previous version was at before we can release it. We don't want you to not be able to fish, which at the moment in v2 not everything is in place, so you wouldn't be able to enjoy the experience.

We anticipate over the coming months, work will continue at a decent pace and with your feedback we can make Carp Fishing Simulator the angling experience you've all been craving for.

Thanks again for your support.
